title: Q3 2026 insider stock sales: Nvidia's Mark Stevens tops AI sellers
key_facts: Nvidia director Mark Stevens sold more than $946 million of Nvidia shares in the third quarter, according to records compiled by Washington Service and recent regulatory filings.
The transactions involved 4,236,740 shares for a combined value of $946.63 million, spread across several transactions.
Stevens sold more than $300 million of Nvidia stock in September alone, after more sales earlier in the month.
Nvidia's shares have gained nearly 30% this year, though several other semiconductor companies have posted larger advances.
The filings do not give a reason for the sales.
Stevens remains a major shareholder, holding Nvidia shares directly and through trusts.
quote_evidence: The regulatory documents do not provide a reason for the transactions.
Stevens remains a major shareholder of Nvidia, meaning the sales represent only part of his reported investment in the company.
why_it_matters_hint: A board member sold about $946 million of Nvidia stock in Q3; the filings give no reason and he keeps a large stake.
